gold_review.explanation: `answer` is a JSON dump of the whole game state (remaining_words, groups, lives...), not something the model should output. The game is multi-turn: it needs four separate `<guess>w1, w2, w3, w4</guess>` turns, one per group, which a single verbatim reply can't produce. success, progress and efficiency all read the found_groups that env_response mutates into state['answer'].
